statements.sql: SELECT usage_metadata.job_id AS job_id, usage_metadata.job_run_id AS job_run_id, billing_origin_product, sku_name, round(sum(usage_quantity), 4) AS dbu, min(usage_start_time) AS first_start, max(usage_end_time) AS last_end, count(*) AS records FROM system.billing.usage WHERE usage_unit = 'DBU' AND usage_metadata.job_run_id IN ('770308767976003') GROUP BY ALL
SELECT max(usage_end_time) AS latest_usage_end, current_timestamp() AS queried_at FROM system.billing.usage
